about: Retained independent review verdicts projected from historical provenance; no new acceptance is claimed. Each digest binds the exact comparison rules reviewed.

reviewer.by: independent review of the fixed 1.0.0 -> 1.0.1 golden comparisons
reviewer.verdict: confirmed: a third independent review re-recorded every golden at review-golden-comparisons on a fresh host (identical to the committed files) and found the fixed 1.0.0 -> 1.0.1 comparisons exactly D-01 in both comparators, with the same coverage (ESM D-01a 316, D-01b 6, D-01c 948; CJS D-01a 10, D-01b 6, D-01c 2, D-01d 466), and the label guard refusing D-01 for a mutated 1.0.1 copy, a 1.0.0 baseline and a tampered golden (exit 2). The earlier finding at the pre-fold commit (removal and message rules broad enough to hide a dropped chunk or a changed message) was closed by narrowing them to the error-frame items, the frame texts and the error-frame cases of the fixed comparison; this review confirms the narrowed rules.

reviewer.by: independent review of the TypeScript client recording against the @agentcc/client 1.0.1 golden
reviewer.verdict: accepted at historical-change-022: User-Agent futureagi-typescript/<v> and x-agentcc-sdk-version <v> on every request; 972 differences per format, value-pinned; at historical-change-022 the ESM and CJS recordings (each from two install paths) were byte-identical to those the entries were built from (typescript-overlay-source, historical-change-006). Reviewed again at review-typescript-client with the rules as they now stand (the 1.0.1 values pinned exactly, the new values in the version shape D-03-py uses): 972 differences per format covered, and each of the 2438 differences per format is covered by exactly one entry. That review also found that these rules alone do not keep the release gate passing on a version bump: TS-3.2-dts-surface pinned the sha256 of constants.d.ts, into which tsc wrote the VERSION literal, so a bump left those two differences unlisted in both formats. That is fixed in TS-3.2-dts-surface (VERSION is declared string), not here
